text_block_list.text:
Days of bustling about to gather Umamusume 
on Tracen Island continued!

I've tried coming up with creative ideas 
and doing various activities in my own 
way... but I feel like things have gotten 
a bit repetitive.

To search for a better way, I want to look 
at someone else's activities for 
inspiration. The name that suddenly popped 
into my mind was—

I decided to go check on Ines Fuujin! 
Wondering where she might be, I went 
looking for her—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Store Manager! Sorry to bother you! Could 
I put up this flyer here? I made it myself 
this time, though—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Store Manager~! Do you have a second~? I 
have a small favor to ask—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Master! I am so sorry!

"She went around visiting all the shops 
she had connections with at incredible 
speed...!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew! I think that covers everywhere we 
could ask—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you startled me?! What are you doing 
here?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You saw all of that~? Jeez, I 
didn't notice at all!
choice_data_list: You really worked hard, didn't you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Well, naturally!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I really love the training 
facilities on that island♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I love Tracen Academy too, of course, but 
this place has a completely different 
charm to it~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That's part of it, too! How should 
I put it... when I'm running, I get this 
mysterious feeling!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"When I run through those deep forests and 
along the coast, wrapped in the scents of 
nature—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Forgetting the hectic days filled with 
races and part-time jobs... even the 
academy, my friends, and above all, my 
precious family.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It makes me feel as if there's only one 
Ines Fujin in the whole wide world.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what am I even saying! Ahaha! I 
guess it just shows how much I've grown to 
love it.

At any rate... Tracen Island seemed to be 
becoming a very precious place for Ines 
Fujin as well.

I decided to go check on Gold City! Now, 
let's see where she is—

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
Today's guest is Gold City-san, who is 
making huge waves both on the track and in 
modeling!
Gold City was appearing on the TV!

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
—Umm, so apparently there's a "super hot 
spot" recommended by City-san!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yes. At a place called Tracen Island.

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
This is the place that served as the stage 
for the "Deserted Island PJ" City-san is 
taking part in, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The staff member over there— the 
person in charge and site supervisor, they 
are working incredibly hard.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
She's a passionate, kind-hearted person 
who truly cares about the Umamusume. She 
prays for their growth from the bottom of 
her heart.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's a new style of training facility 
built by someone like that. The concept is 
innovative, and you can train your body in 
completely different ways.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And... the view was really nice.

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text: The view, is it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's an untouched land, so surrounded by 
the sea, there are forests completely 
untouched by humans. There are animals, 
birds, bugs, and the scent of soil and 
grass—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: My heart is...—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
An important thing... Calling it 
"remembering" feels a bit strange, but 
that's what it feels like.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I ended up thinking about things that are 
a bit out of character for me.

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text: I see...! A "super hot spot", right!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm looking for girls who'd like to 
train together, so feel free to join if 
you'd like.

Tracen Island seemed to be becoming a very 
precious place for Gold City as well.

Now then, while searching around for where 
she could be— She was doing intense muscle 
training together with several other 
Umamusume, including one with braided 
pigtails!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Keep it going! It's working, it's working! 
Look at those biceps popping, everyone--!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu*...! Ngh... damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up, don't lose!! Picture who 
you want to be tomorrow!! Go, go, go, go! 
Hang in there, you can do it!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Nwaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I'm doing this training while 
showing you around Tracen Island at the 
same time. It's steady work, but 
surprisingly effective—

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's super effective, so it's become 
a huge trend in our class!

text_block_list.name: Bun-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it feels super refreshing. I guess 
Ryan-san really is great at teaching, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No. Isn't that just... because it's a 
different place than usual?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Feeling frustrated, wanting to give 
up... Racing really brings out all kinds 
of emotions, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy's facilities are top-notch, 
but I think it's packed full of memories 
like that too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's none of that stuff around 
here yet. So I thought maybe you could 
train with a fresh mindset.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Like a brand-new, pristine sketchbook... 
or a love that has just begun—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I think it might be that kind of place 
too.

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
......Ryan-san carries such a cool vibe, 
but she's actually quite girly, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! T-T-That's not true at all, you 
know?!

Tracen Island seemed to be becoming a very 
precious place for Mejiro Ryan as well.

I decided to go check on Sakura Chiyono O! 
Now, let's see where she is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's move on to the 
explanations for each facility on Tracen 
Island!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
First is the diving facility! It obviously 
trains lung capacity, but that's not all—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore! The incline of this mountain 
trail is steeper than the academy's slope! 
The footing is unstable too, which demands 
intense concentration—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, you can enjoy all 
kinds of scenery in every direction!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Even for those who feel Tracen Academy's 
facilities are enough, this will become a 
place that brings extra added value!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes Sakura Chiyono O's 
Recommendation for Island Training! That's 
all~!
(Clap clap clap...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh? Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha...! I just thought it might pique 
your interest a little.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I've actually been taking notes 
ever since I joined the project.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's not every day you get to see how a 
training facility is built up close! So I 
guess I also put it together while I had 
the chance.
choice_data_list: As expected, you're so eager to learn.

As expected, you're always so eager to 
learn.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Thank you very much. But I still 
have a long way to go. I learn something 
every single time I go.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We have lots of fun training exercises 
like mazes and coin hunts, but every 
single one of them has a real purpose.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The importance of linking seldom-used 
muscles with the brain. Efficient training 
for judgment and dynamic visual acuity. 
The harmony of cutting-edge sports science 
and Mother Nature—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The more I learn, the more... interesting 
it gets! I can really feel Tucker-san's 
passion. That's why I want to do whatever 
I can to help!

Tracen Island seemed to be becoming a very 
precious place for Sakura Chiyono O as 
well.

I decided to go check on Tamamo Cross! Now 
then, where could she be? As I looked 
around—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, step right up, step right 
uuup! Get yer piping-hot, delicious 
takoyaki right hereee!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Oh! Hey there, Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Hang on a sec, we're almost at our 
break!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yep! We're project partners after all, so 
this is a present from me!

Looking inside, beneath the piping-hot 
takoyaki— a flyer was slipped in, reading: 
"Desert Island Project: Testers Wanted!"
choice_data_list: As expected, you never miss a trick!
As expected, you never miss a trick!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah, I forgot to pull it out! Sorry, sorry!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nice and smooth to hand over, right? I 
took a short-term gig here just for this!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm the type who likes to do whatever I 
can, y'know. I actually really like that 
place!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Runnin' races, training, and on top of 
that, bein' part of a project... it's 
tough work."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, those were a fun few years 
regardless. I got to talk with folks I 
usually wouldn't have.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Um, Tamamo Leader-san. I have a question 
about the afternoon tasks~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look, Leader Tamamo! Isn't this 
coloring super genius? Let's make this our 
Insta-worthy photo spot♡

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Leader Tamamo. Running alongside the 
ostrich—it's more fun than I thought... 
Fufu, ufufu...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
They even entrusted me with being leader 
and all that, after all. Not that I've 
done anything, though!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If a place like that is in trouble, of 
course you'd wanna do something! Right?

Tracen Island seemed to be becoming a very 
precious place for Tamamo Cross as well.

I decided to go check on Tucker Brine! Now 
then, as I look around for where he might 
be--

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Hup, hah♪ Fuu, fuu—fuu♪
She was dancing.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—Oho! Hahaha! You caught me in an 
embarrassing spot, eh!
choice_data_list: So dancing is your hobby, I see

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Dancing is a hobby of mine, that's trueâ 
but this is dance exercise! I was just 
coming up with the choreography!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I used to use it a lot as my own 
unique training method! So I'm quite used 
to it!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume watch exercise videos on social 
media these days, don't they? What was it 
called, Somethin'-Tube—"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Nah, maybe it's 'cause I lived on a 
deserted island for a while, but I'm 
totally out of touch with what's trendy! 
Especially social media, beats me 
completely! Anyway—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I heard it would catch the eyes of many 
young people! That is why I was making it, 
hoping it would help attract them to 
Tracen Island!

"...In short, it seems they plan to post 
an exercise video on UmaTube as part of 
promoting Tracen Island!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! If you're free, could you 
lend me a hand?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Step, step, one-two♪ Ha-ha, you can do it, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—Seven, eight, nine, ten, finish! Alright! 
Good work out there!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
So, how was it? The intensity of a 
human-level workout!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, is that so! In that case, I'll 
tone down the intensity a bit for the 
human-oriented ones. Thank you, that 
really helps!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Alright, all that's left is recording a 
video— and having them post it on Umadube 
and... Twitbear? Or whatever that social 
media is called!

I feel like I may have misheard something 
outrageous... Still, Tracen Island clearly 
means a lot to her, and she was fired up 
and ready to go!
